QuestInfo.name: Words of Ill Omen
QuestInfo.0: That voice... The Black Mage is already awake! Maybe you can talk him out of this whole 'evil' thing.
QuestInfo.1: The Black Mage tells you to put down the stone and follow him. \r\nYou're not sure how to respond.
QuestInfo.2: The Black Mage is already awake! He tells you to put down the stone and follow him. \r\nYou refuse, obviously, but as you're about to finish fixing the seal, it breaks and the Black Mage disappears. \r\nHe leaves you with some rather haunting words.
